---
title: "Before the session"
---
Before the session you read the background page and check that the deck of the session loads on the machine that you will bring. The two steps take about an hour, and there is nothing to install and nothing to register for.

## 1. Background {#the-case-study}

[Read the background](../../cases/housing/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The background page presents the original study and its design, SCORE and its robustness study (Multi100; Aczel et al. 2026), the five reanalyses and the question that each of them answered, how their results were put on one scale, and the replication with new data. Read it before you come, because the session works on this case study throughout and can give it only a few slides.

## 2. The deck

[Open the deck](slides.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 1](../../cases/housing/lab.qmd#task-1-setup){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

The deck of the session runs R inside your browser, with the data already in place, and its slides carry the cells of the tasks. Open it once on the machine and in the browser that you will use, wait until the setup cell shows a "Run Code" button, and run it. If it does not load, try another browser, and tell the facilitator before the session. The browser lab, a page of the course site that holds the same tasks outside the deck, is the fallback.

**By the start of the session** you have the deck loading on the machine that you will use, and you know what the claim is and how the five analysts of the robustness study came to different conclusions about it.
